name: Stability Ball Rotational Back Extension
steps: Lie face down with the ball under your hips and lower abdomen, feet spread wide and fingertips beside your ears.
Lower your chest smoothly over the curve of the ball into the starting position.
Contract your lower back and glutes to lift your torso upward while rotating your chest smoothly toward one side at the top.
Unwind back to center, lower smoothly over the ball, and rotate toward the opposite side on the next repetition, alternating sides continuously.
tips: Rotate gently through your mid-back and obliques without forcing an extreme spinal arch.
Keep your neck neutral and avoid pulling on your head with your hands.
